title: Drywall Installation and Finish Readiness
markdown:
# RCS Day 6 - Drywall Installation and Finish Readiness
CTS Cohort 6 | CTS Day 14 | 2026-07-28 | 10:00 AM-3:00 PM

## Core rule
A professional does not guess. A professional checks, protects, and verifies.

## Big idea
Finish quality is built through planning: inspect rough-in, measure openings, support the board, fasten correctly, control dust, and protect hidden systems.

## Architecture of the day
| Time | Instructor move |
|---|---|
| 10:00-10:15 | Arrival, PPE, retrieval warm-up |
| 10:15-10:30 | Morning quiz |
| 10:30-10:50 | Quiz review and pre-cover misconception check |
| 10:50-11:20 | Pre-cover inspection and opening-layout model |
| 11:20-12:00 | Score/snap, cutout, and panel-handling demonstration |
| 12:00-12:30 | Fastener QC, dust-control plan, and lab release |
| 12:30-1:00 | Lunch and controlled reset |
| 1:00-2:25 | Individual drywall fit and fastening lab |
| 2:25-2:45 | Finish-readiness inspection, evidence, cleanup |
| 2:45-3:00 | Exit ticket and Day 7 preview |

## Learning targets
- Complete a pre-cover inspection of framing and rough-in
- Measure and cut a 4-foot by 3-foot drywall panel
- Fit the panel around the window and device boxes
- Fasten and prepare the surface for finishing

## Materials and setup
- Six 4-foot by 3-foot drywall panels plus practice offcuts
- T-squares, tape measures, pencils, utility knives, rasps, and panel supports
- Approved drywall fasteners and controlled drivers
- Window/device-box opening templates and pre-cover checklists
- Product SDS, ventilation/housekeeping controls, and required PPE
- Sample tape/compound station and evidence devices

## Instructor talking points
- Explain why rough-in and evidence must be complete before covering the wall.
- Demonstrate measurement transfer, box-opening layout, score-and-snap, supported cutting, edge handling, and controlled fastening.
- Compare correct fastener dimples with protruding and overdriven fasteners.
- Introduce tape and compound sequencing; emphasize finish-ready rather than rushed finish.
- Review dust control, housekeeping, and product-specific PPE/SDS requirements.
